recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The approved FHIR-33997 clarification is already represented in current source; further changes would be redundant unless a separate future Jira decides to revise the _filter grammar more broadly.
issue_request: FHIR-33997 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request for R5 asking the _filter specification to clarify whether _has and composite search parameters such as code-value-quantity are supported, including the syntax and grammar.
initial_application: No Jira-keyed source commit was found. The apparent source application is cf2bd24c028dbbb0fbef1a09e6c96930a5b9394c, which added the composite and _has examples, reverse-chaining prose, hasSpecifier grammar, and composite eq/ne note to source/search_filter.html. A later FHIR-41013 reconciliation corrected the same composite example's value syntax.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread shows the reporter asking the same _filter composite/_has questions and filing FHIR-33997. A later FHIR-I Zulip thread shows Grahame drafting the hasSpecifier grammar, with Gino confirming it and noting dateChar ':'/'Z' additions that are present now. FHIR-I minutes record Gino taking the syntax action and the later 12-0-0 Persuasive vote. source/search_filter.html is in build scope through source/hierarchy.xml and active links from source/search.html.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. Current source/search_filter.html includes a corrected composite code-value-quantity example using '$', an _has example, explicit reverse-chaining guidance, hasSpecifier grammar, and a note that composite _filter evaluation is appropriate only for eq/ne.

related_jiras.note: Corrected the composite search value syntax in source/search.html and the active source/search_filter.html example; already represented on the combined branch.
Later Applied clarification about chained search evaluation and _filter for grouped joins; relevant background but separate from the FHIR-33997 _has/composite syntax decision.
